description: Probe-only rejection library for hipkernel:Gfx1151WmmaAttentionDecode (the rocKE RDNA WMMA split-KV, GQA-packed decode SDPA forward, gfx11 and gfx12; the 24 shipped decode objects of descriptors/rocKE/gfx1151_wmma_attention_decode/gfx1151_wmma_attention_decode.kdp.json: half or bfloat16, the head-size buckets 64, 128 and 256, bias none, f32 and q, mask class 'runtime'; kernel rocke/library/kernels/gfx1151/wmma_fmha_decode.py): a legal graph the engine takes (BSHD or BHSD, half or bfloat16, head size 64, 128 or 256 for Q, K, V and O, grouped-query heads, a short seqlen_q of 1 to 64 that the rocKE dispatcher routes to decode, scale 0.0883883, declared alignment 16 on every operand, no mask) with ONE feature per case, named by the `family` axis; the base shape is the `shape` axis, a [dtype, layout, B, Hq, Hkv, Sq, Skv, head size] tuple, the `odd` axis carries the per-family odd values by position (see below), and `odd[7]` (the operand: q, k, v or o) and `odd[8]` (a declared alignment of 1, 2, 4 or 8 bytes) pick the operand and the alignment of the families that vary one tensor. Every family is a graph the frontend accepts (the graphs the frontend rejects are not drawn: Hq not divisible by the K or the V head count, SdpaFwdNode.hpp lines 129-152; an attn_mask whose last dim is neither Skv nor 1 or whose second-to-last is neither Sq nor 1, lines 184-199; left_bound 0, SEM-005). `expect` is `declined` where the engine's code must refuse the graph (the kernel has no input for the feature or a stated unsupported configuration, so an accept computes something else) and `declined_or_pass` where a correct engine may take it (then it must be right). This space was authored on a machine with a real gfx1151 device but NOT yet run on it: the engine build was still in progress, so nothing below was observed on the device and every claim is what the code and the shipped descriptors say, proven so far only by the pytest load, sample and render tests of this space. Lines cited are in dnn-providers/hip-kernel-provider/src/engines/kernel_ingestor_engine/packs/Gfx1151WmmaAttentionNative.cpp unless noted; gfx1151WmmaAttentionGraphMatches (lines 673-841) is the graph matcher both Gfx1151 engines share, decodeKernelMatches (lines 1176-1181, kernelMatchesFor lines 1128-1167) the decode engine's kernel matcher, and the kernel matcher is the only place a graph can be taken, so every `declined` is a path that ends in return std::nullopt or false. DECODE VERSUS PREFILL: the decode engine takes exactly what the rocKE dispatcher routes to decode (usesDecode, lines 1087-1099: rdnaAttentionUseDecode, lines 234-256, on the key range any row sees, decodeKvRange, lines 215-225, and a decodeBucket that exists) and what decodePlanFor (lines 1032-1084) can launch; the prefill engine declines those (catalogDecodePlan, lines 1107-1124). The rule depends on the device's compute-unit count (twice HIP's multiProcessorCount: usesDecode passes 2 * deviceMultiprocessors, line 1097); the base shapes route to decode at 32 and at 40 compute units (the two Strix Halo sizes, [INFERENCE] 8050S and 8060S), and the prefill_routed shapes route to prefill at both. none: control, the base graph, which the engine takes: declined_or_pass. prefill_routed: `odd[5]` is a (B, Hkv, group, Sq, Skv) tuple the dispatcher sends to prefill: Sq above 64 with 4 * B * Hq * ceil(Sq / 128) at least 40 (lines 244-249: (1, 16, 1, 128, 256), (2, 8, 2, 129, 512), (1, 16, 1, 65, 128), (4, 4, 2, 1024, 128), (2, 32, 1, 129, 64)), and Sq of at most 64 with group * Sq at least 512, at least 64 * 40 visible keys and at least 512 * 40 batch * keys (lines 254-255: (8, 1, 8, 64, 4096), (3, 1, 16, 32, 8192), (5, 1, 16, 32, 4096)); usesDecode is false, decodeKernelMatches returns false (line 1154) and no decode object is a candidate: declined (the SdpaFwd/Gfx1151 prefill engine takes these). head_not_mult8: `odd[0]` head sizes that are not a multiple of 8 (100, 4, 63 with 64, 64 with 100, 130, 20, 257 with 128, 128 with 12); isServedHeadDim (lines 503-507) and the matcher (lines 693-700) decline, and decodeBucket (line 199) has no bucket: declined. head_over_256: `odd[1]` head sizes above 256 (264, 320, 512, 288 with 64, 64 with 288, 1024 with 64, 256 with 512, 384 with 128); MAX_HEAD_DIM is 256 (line 151, isServedHeadDim line 505): declined. head_q_below_min: `odd[2]` multiples of 8 the graph matcher takes but decodeBucket does not: the Q/K width is below the smallest the bucket serves (16 for the 64 bucket, 72 for 128, 136 for 256; lines 203-209, rocKE wmma_fmha_decode_bucket docstring, lines 1810-1826: K chunks below the minimum load unmasked, so NaN or Inf bytes past the row would poison the scores) as for (8, 8), (8, 64), (8, 16), (64, 72), (64, 128), (64, 256), (128, 256), (72, 200); decodeKernelMatches line 1155 finds no object: declined (the prefill engine, whose bucket is the tightest (Q/K, V/O) pair holding the widths, may take them). head_dv_differs: `odd[3]` a V and O head size different from Q and K that decodeBucket serves, because V has no lower bound (docstring lines 1817-1818) and the kernel takes the runtime widths head_dim_q and head_dim_v (kernel docstring lines 53-59; matcher lines 691-692): (128, 64), (256, 64), (128, 8), (256, 136), (136, 256), (72, 128), (16, 8), (64, 16): declined_or_pass. kv_heads_differ: V has a different head count than K, one dividing the other (V one head, or Hq heads when K has one); the matcher takes any head counts that divide Hq (line 695-696), decodePlanFor packs max(Hkv, Hv) groups (lines 1040-1046) and the kernel docstring (wmma_fmha_decode_pack_groups, lines 1848-1861) ships that: declined_or_pass. kv_heads_no_pack: `odd[4]` an (Hq, Hk, Hv) triple whose K and V head counts both divide Hq but neither divides the other ((6, 2, 3), (12, 4, 6), (12, 3, 2), (12, 6, 4), (30, 6, 10), (6, 3, 2), (12, 2, 3), (20, 4, 10)); decodePlanFor line 1040 (max(Hk, Hv) % min(Hk, Hv) != 0) returns nullopt, which kernelMatchesFor reads at line 1156: declined. dt_q_other, dt_k_other, dt_v_other, dt_o_other: one of Q, K, V, O in the other 16-bit type (half versus bfloat16); the problem's dtype is Q's and K, V and O must equal it (lines 709-713), and an accepted graph would read or write a buffer as the wrong type: declined. dt_o_float: float O with 16-bit inputs, line 709: declined. dt_all_float: all four fp32; supportedDataTypeName (lines 385-396) knows only half and bfloat16 and no fp32 object ships: declined. attn_mask_dtype_other: an additive mask [1, 1, Sq, Skv] in the other 16-bit type; biasFor takes FP32 or Q's dtype only (lines 566-580): declined. attn_mask_key_bcast: a mask [1, 1, Sq, 1] with a broadcast key axis; biasFor line 549 needs dims[3] == Skv: declined. attn_mask_key_stride: a mask [1, 1, Sq, Skv] with key stride 2 (lines 550-551 need a unit key stride when Skv > 1): declined. attn_mask_align_f32: an FP32 mask declared at alignment 2 and attn_mask_align_q a Q-dtype mask declared at alignment 1; biasFor line 581 needs the declared alignment to be a multiple of the element size (4, 2; BIAS note lines 172-175): declined. scale_tensor_device: a device-resident scale tensor (not pass-by-value) with no attn_scale_value; scaleFor accepts only a pass-by-value tensor (line 643-647): declined. scale_tensor_value: a runtime pass-by-value scale tensor of float; scaleFor takes it and reads it at launch (lines 658-663, launch lines 1599-1611), the references grade it (the SdpaFwdRuntimeScale bundles): declined_or_pass. scale_neg (-0.125) and scale_zero (0.0): the kernels take log2(e) * scale and require it above 0 (line 666 and comment 621-626): declined. seq_len_q, seq_len_kv (one tensor each) and padding (padding_mask with both): lines 769-770 and 788: declined. dropout_philox (dropout_probability 0.1 with seed and offset), dropout_mask (explicit mask and scale tensors) and rng_dump (dropout plus an rng_dump output): lines 770-775 and 787: declined. dropout_zero: dropout_probability 0.0 alone; unlike the gfx950 and FlyDSL engines this matcher declines only a nonzero probability (lines 774-775), so a probability of zero is taken as no dropout: declined_or_pass. paged_kv (page tables and max_seq_len_kv, with a single 64-row block so K and V keep a dense shape; also needs seq_len tensors and padding_mask), block_mask, sink (a float [1, Hq, 1, 1] sink token), descale_qkv (descale_q, descale_k, descale_v), fp8_softmax_scales (descale_s, scale_s, scale_o, amax_s, amax_o) and row_stats (stats with max and sum_exp): the kernels' sinks, paging, FP8 and row-statistics operands are not bound by this engine (comment lines 766-768; checks lines 776-787): declined. alibi: alibi_mask with right_bound 0, line 787: declined. stats_no_flag (a stats tensor with generate_stats unset) and stats_flag_false (stats tensor with generate_stats false): lines 756-758; stats_flag_no_tensor (generate_stats true and no tensor): lines 737-739; stats_half (a half stats tensor): line 744 needs FLOAT; stats_align (a float stats tensor declared at alignment 2): line 751 needs a multiple of LSE_ALIGN_BYTES, 4: all declined. stats_unpacked: a float stats tensor [B, Hq, Sq, 1] with strides [Sq * Hq, 1, Hq, 1] (position-major, not packed head-major); the kernels take the three LSE strides (runtimeArguments lines 1366-1402, kernel signature lines 1296-1325), isWellFormedOperand accepts it: declined_or_pass. masked_rows_causal and masked_rows_window: queries that see no key (B, Hq, Hkv from the base shape, Sq 4 and Skv 2; bottom-right causal, or a top-left window left_bound 1 with right_bound 0): no code in this engine declines it (maskFor lines 413-453 takes both), but the references give such a row a zero output and an LSE of -inf (CpuFpReferenceSdpa.hpp, 'fully masked rows') and the kernel is not described to define it; the supported-region space SdpaFwd/Gfx1151Decode excludes these rows for that reason (its rows_see_a_key constraint), so this is the one place they are drawn: declined_or_pass. window_left_i32 and window_right_i32: a left_bound or right_bound past int32 (`odd[6]`: 2**31 to 2**48); maskFor line 427 (fitsI32): declined. align_low: the declared alignment of one of Q, K, V, O (operand `odd[7]`) is `odd[8]` (1, 2, 4 or 8 bytes): the kernels load rows as 16-byte vectors and the matcher needs every operand's declared alignment to be a multiple of QKVO_ALIGN_BYTES, 16 (lines 721-730, constant lines 155-177): declined. row_stride_pad: one of Q, K, V, O (operand `odd[7]`) with its row stride (BSHD token stride, BHSD sequence stride) padded by 4 elements, not a multiple of 8 elements; hasAlignedRows (lines 355-365, call line 716): declined. head_dim_stride: one of Q, K, V, O (operand `odd[7]`) laid out with a head-dim stride other than 1 (the sequence axis unit, head dim stride Sq + 1 or Skv + 1); isWellFormedOperand line 319-322: declined. implementation_composite and implementation_unified: `implementation` other than AUTO, line 789: declined. mma_float: mma_core_mode float; UNSET, FLOAT, HALF and BFLOAT16 are accepted because the kernels accumulate in FP32 (lines 798-806): declined_or_pass. mma_fp8: mma_core_mode fp8_e4m3, outside that list (line 801-803): declined. overflow: `ovf` names one 32-bit limit pushed past the bound at enforcement_level buildable (no tensor is allocated, filled or executed); Q, K, V and O must address under 2**31 bytes (addressFitsI32 line 367-383, applied at line 716: kv_seq: Skv = 2**23, kv_batch: B = 2**14, kv_heads: Hkv = Hq = 2**16, q_seq: Sq = 2**24, q_batch: B = 2**17, q_heads: Hq = 2**17 with one K head), every stride and dimension must fit int32 (fitsI32, line 314 and 694: kv_int64: Skv = 2**40, q_seq_u32: Sq = 2**32, q_int64: B, Hq and Sq each 2**22), and the mask must too (bias_span: a [1, 1, 128, 2**23] Q-dtype mask over a 16-wide head spans 2**31 bytes while K stays at 2**28, biasFor line 585). The decode grid and workspace limits (decodePlanFor lines 1066-1082) cannot be the first to fail: a grid or workspace past int32 needs a Q or O of far more than 2**31 elements first, so there is no family for them. Strides are the exact dense BSHD strides of the huge dims. `expect` is `declined`; an accepted and built overflow case is reported `UNEXERCISED` with the reason `accepted above the oracle ceiling`. Not drawn: Hq not divisible by Hkv (the frontend rejects it), and the supported features of the engine (the bias none, f32 and q kinds, stats, masks, window), which SdpaFwd/Gfx1151Decode covers. The space is probe-only and never frozen into a bundle.

derive.b_e: ovf[1] if ov else (rt[0] if pr else shape[2])
derive.hkv: ovf[3] if ov else (rt[1] if pr else (hs[1] if np else shape[4]))
derive.hq: ovf[2] if ov else (rt[1] * rt[2] if pr else (hs[0] if np else shape[3]))
derive.hv: hs[2] if np else ((1 if hkv != 1 else hq) if family == 'kv_heads_differ' else hkv)
derive.sq_e: ovf[4] if ov else (rt[3] if pr else (4 if mr else shape[5]))
derive.skv_e: ovf[5] if ov else (rt[4] if pr else (2 if mr else (64 if family == 'paged_kv' else shape[6])))
derive.dqk: (ovf[6] if ov else (odd[0][0] if family == 'head_not_mult8' else (odd[1][0] if family == 'head_over_256' else (odd[2][0] if family == 'head_q_below_min' else (odd[3][0] if family == 'head_dv_differs' else (64 if pr else shape[7]))))))
derive.dv: (ovf[6] if ov else (odd[0][1] if family == 'head_not_mult8' else (odd[1][1] if family == 'head_over_256' else (odd[2][1] if family == 'head_q_below_min' else (odd[3][1] if family == 'head_dv_differs' else dqk)))))
derive.stride_q: [hq*dqk*(sq_e+1), dqk*(sq_e+1), 1, sq_e+1] if (family == 'head_dim_stride' and operand == 'q') else ([sq_e*(hq*dqk+p_q), dqk, hq*dqk+p_q, 1] if lay == 'bshd' else [hq*sq_e*(dqk+p_q), sq_e*(dqk+p_q), dqk+p_q, 1])
derive.stride_k: [hkv*dqk*(skv_e+1), dqk*(skv_e+1), 1, skv_e+1] if (family == 'head_dim_stride' and operand == 'k') else ([skv_e*(hkv*dqk+p_k), dqk, hkv*dqk+p_k, 1] if lay == 'bshd' else [hkv*skv_e*(dqk+p_k), skv_e*(dqk+p_k), dqk+p_k, 1])
derive.stride_v: [hv*dv*(skv_e+1), dv*(skv_e+1), 1, skv_e+1] if (family == 'head_dim_stride' and operand == 'v') else ([skv_e*(hv*dv+p_v), dv, hv*dv+p_v, 1] if lay == 'bshd' else [hv*skv_e*(dv+p_v), skv_e*(dv+p_v), dv+p_v, 1])
derive.stride_o: [hq*dv*(sq_e+1), dv*(sq_e+1), 1, sq_e+1] if (family == 'head_dim_stride' and operand == 'o') else ([sq_e*(hq*dv+p_o), dv, hq*dv+p_o, 1] if lay == 'bshd' else [hq*sq_e*(dv+p_o), sq_e*(dv+p_o), dv+p_o, 1])
derive.dtq: 'float' if family == 'dt_all_float' else (other if family == 'dt_q_other' else dtype)
derive.dtk: 'float' if family == 'dt_all_float' else (other if family == 'dt_k_other' else dtype)
derive.dtv: 'float' if family == 'dt_all_float' else (other if family == 'dt_v_other' else dtype)
derive.dto: 'float' if family in ['dt_all_float', 'dt_o_float'] else (other if family == 'dt_o_other' else dtype)
derive.scale_value: None if family in ['scale_tensor_device', 'scale_tensor_value'] else (-0.125 if family == 'scale_neg' else (0.0 if family == 'scale_zero' else 0.0883883461356163))
derive.right: 0 if family in ['alibi', 'masked_rows_causal', 'masked_rows_window'] else (odd[6] if family == 'window_right_i32' else None)
derive.dtb: 'float' if family == 'attn_mask_align_f32' else (other if family == 'attn_mask_dtype_other' else dtype)
derive.bias_align: 2 if family == 'attn_mask_align_f32' else (1 if family == 'attn_mask_align_q' else 16)
derive.dims_bias: [1, 1, sq_e, 1] if family == 'attn_mask_key_bcast' else [1, 1, sq_e, skv_e]
derive.stride_bias: [sq_e, sq_e, 1, 1] if family == 'attn_mask_key_bcast' else ([2*sq_e*skv_e, 2*sq_e*skv_e, 2*skv_e, 2] if family == 'attn_mask_key_stride' else [sq_e*skv_e, sq_e*skv_e, skv_e, 1])
